onboarding.welcomeDescription: Let's get your account ready in two steps, then we'll show you the dashboard. What's your name?
onboarding.nameSaveError: Your name could not be saved. Retry, or skip the tour and add it later from Settings.
onboarding.areaDescription: The active area defines which region you monitor: the map, indicators and alerts are scoped to it. You can change it anytime from the header.

map.title: Epicenter map
map.description: This is where the seismic events of your area of interest live in real time: each circle is an earthquake, sized and colored by magnitude. You can enable layers (tectonic plates, cities) from the Layers button.

globe.title: 3D Globe
globe.description: The same seismic activity, but on an interactive globe: ideal for seeing global activity at a glance and understanding patterns at planetary scale.

areas.title: Areas of interest
areas.description: Choose which region to monitor: Andes, Japan, Cascadia and more. The active area drives the whole dashboard — map, indicators, events table and alerts.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: The bell gathers the active alerts: significant events, swarms and felt activity in your area. The number shows how many there are right now.

hero.subtitle: Global seismic monitoring in real time: continuous ingestion from USGS, EMSC and INPRES, swarm detection, live spectrograms and alerts on the areas you care about.

how.title: From the sensor to your screen, in one continuous flow

steps.title: Multi-source ingestion
steps.description: M3.0+ events worldwide from USGS, EMSC and INPRES, deduplicated and normalized into a single catalog that updates continuously.

steps.title: Real-time analysis
steps.description: Per-area KPIs, swarm detection, significant events and felt activity — computed on the live catalog, not on stale reports.

steps.title: Alerts and visualization
steps.description: 3D globe, maps with tectonic plates and live spectrograms. Alerts fire on your areas of interest, not on the whole world.

features.title: A seismic control room, not another map viewer

items.title: Live 3D globe
items.description: The full Ring of Fire, with no projection cuts: every quake pulses on the sphere, sized and colored by magnitude.

items.title: Maps with tectonic context
items.description: Plate boundaries styled by boundary type, reference cities and automatic framing of the active area.

items.title: Live spectrograms
items.description: Raw seismic signal from stations via SeedLink, rendered in your browser — what the station hears, you see.

items.title: Your own areas of interest
items.description: Define the regions you care about — the Andes, Japan, Cascadia — and the monitor filters events, KPIs and alerts for each one.

items.title: 12 months of history
items.description: A year of queryable catalog to compare today's activity against the region's real baseline.

items.title: Smart alerts
items.description: Swarms, significant events and felt activity — classified by severity, without background noise.

cta.subtitle: Sign in with your Google account and explore global seismic activity with the same tools you see on this page.

footer.tagline: A global seismic control room: live data, tectonic context and alerts on your areas of interest.
